text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Indeed, my comrade. If the world says it is not yet time for it to end, then that is the world's prerogative. I, too, shall continue my "remaining years" with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああとも、
同志。
世界がまだ閉じないと言うなら、
そりゃあ世界の勝手だろう。
ぼくも君との「余生」を続けるぞ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text:
Class is dismissed, Queen of the Sciences. The world is humanities! Humanities are love!
A joint practicum in perception and potential!
text_block_list.orig_text:
閉講の時間だ、
理系の女王。
世界は文系！
　文系は愛！
　認識と発展性の
共同実習！
